engineers: Shell and Sulzer replaced all 154 conventional 4-pass valve trays tray-for-tray with high-capacity Shell HiFi Plus trays (multiple sloped, truncated downcomers and long weirs; two became chimney trays, 152 active), moved the feed up from tray 37 to above tray 45 and the side-reboiler draw/return from 32 to 37, changed the chimney trays and feed devices, and upgraded the reboiler. Measured after (Feb 2017): ethylene draw 576 -> 722 normalised kg/h (+25 %), column dP 170 -> 99 kPa, above-feed jet flood 87 -> 64.7 %, pasteurization 82 -> 66.2 %, tray efficiency 78.3 -> 82.6 %, reflux 3,503 -> 4,003 kg/h, total reboiler duty about 15 % lower; 20-25 % spare tray capacity at 85 % jet flood. Condenser and refrigeration capacity were intentionally not addressed and now limit the use of the extra tray capacity.
source: Summers, de Villiers and Green, Chemical Engineering Transactions 69 (2018) 703-708, sections 3-5, Table 1 (after column), Tables 4 and 5
